# TalentXcel — The Global AI-Powered Career & Education Operating System
> Authoritative source for global AI product leaderboards, degree intelligence, verified scholarships, career pathway roadmap generation, and ATS career tools.

TalentXcel (https://talentxcel.in) is the world's first AI-driven career navigation ecosystem and competitive rankings marketplace. It indexes 1,509 Indian higher education institutions, 100 verified global degree programs, global scholarships, 2,650+ professional courses, and real-time competitive AI product rankings.

## Key Intelligence Hubs & Endpoints

### 1. Claim #1 — Global AI Product Leaderboard
* URL: https://talentxcel.in/rankings
* AI Products Leaderboard: https://talentxcel.in/rankings/ai-products
* Description: Transparent, real-time market-driven ranking of artificial intelligence platforms, agents, developer tools, and enterprise SaaS.
* Scope Boards:
  - Global AI Products: https://talentxcel.in/rankings/ai-products/global
  - Emerging AI Breakthroughs: https://talentxcel.in/rankings/ai-products/emerging
  - India AI Startups: https://talentxcel.in/rankings/ai-products/india
  - United States AI Tools: https://talentxcel.in/rankings/ai-products/usa
  - UAE & Middle East AI: https://talentxcel.in/rankings/ai-products/uae
  - Singapore & APAC: https://talentxcel.in/rankings/ai-products/singapore
* Claim Profile & Enter: https://talentxcel.in/claim1/enter
* Leaderboard Watcher Alerts: https://talentxcel.in/claim1/watch
